body.name: \(\mathsf M_{h,k,J_\pi,J_\mu}^{\mathrm{DP}}\)
body.construction: Deterministically split \(D_n\) into blocks \(D_\pi,D_\mu,D_*\) of size at least \(m\). On \(D_\pi\) and \(D_\mu\), release once per block the concatenated tensor-spline Gram and moment vector by the Gaussian mechanism with its exact joint \(\ell_2\)-sensitivity, solve the ridged normal equations, and post-process by metric projection onto \(\mathcal H^\alpha(L_\pi;\mathcal X)\cap[\kappa,1-\kappa]\) and \(\mathcal H^\beta(L_\mu;\mathcal X)\cap[0,1]\). Conditional on these pilots, form on \(D_*\) the concatenation of all clipped linear and order-two \(U\)-statistic moment entries \((\widehat Q,\widehat R)\) in the Kennedy--Balakrishnan--Robins--Wasserman higher-order local \(R\)-learner using \(\rho_h\), \(b_{h,k}\), and the known uniform design; release this concatenation once by the Gaussian mechanism, spectrally clip \(\widehat Q\) below \(\kappa(1-\kappa)/4\), and return \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{DP}}(x_0;h,k)=\rho_h(x_0)^{\mathsf T}\widehat Q_{\mathrm{DP}}^{-1}\widehat R_{\mathrm{DP}}\). Each of the three disjoint-block mechanisms receives budget \((\epsilon_n,\delta_n)\); the released interval is post-processing.
